description: Start a test checkout for the selected property only when the user requests it. Requires owner:sandbox sign-in. Uses test payments and separate test orders. It does not verify ownership, eligibility, savings or an open appeal window. No real charge or county filing occurs. Show the returned test checkout link when payment is pending. When an order_id is known, read the same order after checkout or an uncertain failure before retrying. If starting checkout fails before an order_id is returned, retry start_tax_sandbox with the original idempotency_key; do not create a new key for the same attempt. get_tax_sandbox_order and complete_tax_sandbox_order take only order_id. Report test payment, draft generation, download availability and external delivery as separate observed states. Do not claim the draft is available until the order confirms its artifact is available; a payment or download URL alone is not proof. A sandbox receipt or simulated submission is not county filing, external email delivery or permission for live payments.
name: start_tax_sandbox
